evidence: Registered new account (Test QA User / qa.tester.revive@example.com); toast "Account created successfully!" shown, user logged in, header shows user name button.

actual: Submitted the registration form again with the same email (qa.tester.revive@example.com) already used to create an account. The app accepted it, showed "Account created successfully!" toast, and redirected to home logged in, instead of rejecting the duplicate registration.

issue: No error/duplicate feedback shown; misleading success toast
actual: Re-registering with an already-used email produced the same "Account created successfully!" toast as a first-time registration, with no indication that the account/email already existed.

evidence: Attempted login with an unregistered email (nonexistent.user.xyz@example.com) and an arbitrary password; app rejected with toast "Invalid credentials. Try: emma@example.com" and stayed on /login.

issue: Incorrect password is accepted for login
actual: Logged in with demo account emma@example.com using an arbitrary/incorrect password ("definitely_wrong_password_123"). Login succeeded with toast "Welcome back!" and the user was authenticated as Emma Green, instead of being rejected for the wrong password.

evidence: As logged-in seller Emma Green, created listing "QA Test Vintage Bicycle" with a photo, description, price ($150), category, condition, and location (Chicago, IL). Toast "Listing created successfully!" shown, and listing appears in My Listings with photo, price, description, and Active status.

issue: No edit/update functionality for listing details
actual: On My Listings page, each listing only offers "View", "Mark Sold", and "Delete" actions. There is no "Edit" button, pencil icon, or any other affordance to modify a listing's title, description, price, category, condition, or location. The product detail page for own listings also has no edit control (only Manage Your Listings link, wishlist, share, and cart icons).

issue: No edit/update functionality for owned product listings
actual: Same as FT-2: reviewed My Listings for seller Emma Green; only View/Mark Sold/Delete actions exist for owned listings, with no way to update listing information (title, price, description, etc.).

evidence: Logged in as Emma Green and viewed a listing owned by a different seller (Sofia Martinez's "Yoga Mat & Blocks Set"). The page shows only "Add to Cart" / "Message Seller" buyer actions, with no owner-management controls (no Mark Sold/Delete/Edit). Emma's "My Listings" page also only lists her own items, not other sellers' listings, so there is no path for a seller to modify another seller's product information.

Clicked "Create Listing" with Title, Description, Price, Category, and Condition all left empty. Form did not submit — stayed on /create-listing, no success toast appeared, and focus moved to the required Title field, indicating client-side required-field validation blocked submission.

Filled Create Listing form with Price = -50 and all other required fields valid; clicking "Create Listing" did not submit the form. The price input has min="0" and native validation reported checkValidity()=false with message "Value must be greater than or equal to 0."
Clicked "Add to Cart" on Yoga Mat & Blocks Set product page. Toast "Added to cart!" appeared and the cart icon in the header updated to show a badge count of "1".
Adding an item to cart immediately produced a toast notification "Added to cart!" and updated the header cart icon badge to "1", providing clear visual feedback.

Added 2 items to cart, went to /cart, clicked "Send Purchase Request". Toast "Purchase requests sent to sellers!" appeared and cart was cleared to 0 items, confirming the purchase request was submitted.

Marcus added Emma's 'Mid-Century Modern Armchair' (prod-1) to cart (badge showed 1). Emma then marked the listing as Sold via My Listings. Upon re-login as Marcus and viewing /cart, the cart displayed 'Your cart is empty / 0 items' - the sold/unavailable item was automatically removed from the cart.

Category filter (Furniture) correctly reduced 9 items to 2 (Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf $320, Upcycled Pallet Coffee Table $175). Condition filter (New) correctly reduced to 3 items, all condition=New. Sort by 'Price: Low to High' correctly reordered items ascending ($35,$45,$55,$65,$95,$125,$175,$180,$320). Price range and distance sliders also present in UI.

Applying category, condition, and sort filters via sidebar checkboxes/combobox updated the product grid and item count instantly within the same page (no navigation/reload), confirming real-time filter updates.

Typing 'Yoga' into the search box correctly filtered the 9-item grid down to the single matching 'Yoga Mat & Blocks Set' listing. Typing further ('YogaVintage', no matching product) correctly showed a 'No items found' empty state with a 'Clear all filters' recovery action.

Search results and the 'N items available' count updated immediately after each keystroke into the searchbox (no submit button pressed, no page navigation), confirming real-time search-as-you-type behavior.

DOM inspection of all 9 active listings shows each product card has a unique, distinct Unsplash photo URL (no shared/generic placeholder images) whose accessible alt text exactly matches the listing title (e.g. 'Yoga Mat & Blocks Set' -> yoga mat photo, 'Vintage Denim Jacket - Size M' -> denim jacket photo, 'Complete Harry Potter Book Set' -> books photo, 'Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf' -> bookshelf photo, 'Sony Noise-Canceling Headphones' -> headphones photo). No mismatched or duplicated images were found across the catalog. Note: verified via DOM/alt-text/src correlation rather than visual screenshot per testing constraints.
